title: kumiko-dispatcher-live is a deprecated shim over kumiko-renderer/live
detail: The package only re-exports @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer/live and is removed after the consumer pass of wave 4.
migration: Import from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer/live, or run bun kumiko codemod package-merge . --write.

title: Responses that match no envelope report their real httpStatus instead of 0
detail: A 401 from a foreign middleware or a proxy 500 with a plain JSON body used to arrive as httpStatus 0, so logic that reacts to 401 or 5xx never fired. The error keeps the code network_error but now carries the response status.

title: dispatcher-live validates server envelopes with Zod
detail: Query, write, batch and stream responses are parsed against Zod schemas for the envelope (isSuccess, error, failedIndex, results); the data payload stays typed by the caller. A malformed envelope now yields the network_error fallback ("unexpected response shape") instead of passing wrongly typed fields through; bare gate errors ({ error } from csrf, origin, auth or rate limits) keep their code, and a missing i18nKey defaults to errors.unknown; a malformed SSE error frame yields stream_error, and failing batch items get httpStatus filled from the response like top-level errors. renderer-web types CSS custom properties on React's CSSProperties instead of casting style objects.

title: Write and batch errors carry httpStatus from the response
detail: dispatcher-live: write and batch failures now take `httpStatus` from the HTTP response when the server's error body omits it, like queries already did. `isSessionEndedError` now also triggers on a failed write after the session ended.
